name: Hewie Elzard
source:
He is a soldier, following in the footsteps of his parents. Has a keen mind for strategy and tactics, seeing through and predicting enemy plans. However, his laid-back attitude results in a demotion. Hewie is the commander of the seventh holy knight corps. His weapon of choice is a sword.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Castle_Fantasia_2:_Seima_Taisen]Wikipedia[/url]]
